convert_flava_checkpoint: convert a Meta FLAVA PyTorch checkpoint to HuggingFace transformers format using a checkpoint path and codebook path
upgrade_state_dict: upgrade a Meta FLAVA state dict to HuggingFace FlavaForPreTraining key naming convention with codebook weights
count_parameters: count the total parameter values in a PyTorch state dict excluding double-copied encoder embeddings
convert_dalle_checkpoint: convert a DALLE checkpoint to FLAVA codebook state dict format for integration into the FLAVA model
build_flava_converter_cli: build a CLI tool to convert Meta FLAVA pre-trained checkpoints to HuggingFace transformers compatible models
